snippet.title: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop! - Official Gameplay Trailer | Multiplayer Organizing Simulator
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4981570?utm_source=socials&utm_campaign=launch&utm_medium=YtDescription

Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop! just launched on Steam, PLAY NOW!

Description: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!
